summary: Algoma Steel Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing only a Notice of Annual Meeting and Management Information Circular for a June 23, 2026, virtual shareholder meeting. The circular covers routine items—receiving financials, electing directors, appointing auditors, and an advisory vote on executive compensation—with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. Nothing in the filing signals a change of control, strategic review, or unusual capital return. As a routine meeting notice, this does not qualify as a special situation. No terms, advisors, or structural details are present.
